# Thunderbird Calendar transaction-manager failed-move recovery

`CalTransactionManager.commit()` and `CalBatchTransaction.commit()` push a transaction, await `doTransaction()`, then remove it from `undoStack` and rethrow if it fails; neither invokes `undoTransaction()` automatically. [Task 1]

Scope: calendar.
